usedFor: Popcorn AI keeps chats per user, and “Send Chat Message” adds to a conversation with its history.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Send Chat Message” in Popcorn AI
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can start a chat message for a specific user.

watchOut: AI agents run on a schedule or when asked, so “Send Chat Message” runs then, not instantly.
